threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the bus is the fastest way to get anywhere. Good luck during the strikes, mate.
Last week on the 381, a guy serenaded the whole bus with 'Wonderwall'—we almost missed our stop, no one could stop laughing.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids using an abandoned car as their personal playground, I realized this neighborhood thrives on innovation and resilience.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin will you find a dive bar with a vintage photo booth in the back, where sweaty punks and hipsters squish in for midnight selfies. Surreal.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can always spot a local by their ability to navigate BART delays like it's a personal challenge, while the newcomers still look baffled on the platform.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 at Civic Center, and a saxophonist jumped on mid-ride, turned a grim delay into a makeshift jazz concert. Only in San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often forget that Gràcia's plazas are actual community hubs, not just photo ops. Locals gather to chat—don’t be surprised if you overhear heated debates!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them at the font de la plaça, clutching a map and discussing how to pronounce 'Vila de Gràcia' like it's some secret code.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep trying to pay with cash at the local markets and getting side-eyed like you’ve just sprouted a third arm.
Caught a late 59 last night; an acapella group took over the backseat, belting out classics. Never knew Brixton buses could feel like a gig.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted the guy in a full suit calmly drinking a beer on the U8 platform, while pigeons took turns stealing fries from kids. Pure Neukölln vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how the U-Bahn stations here have art installations that change every year? It’s like a free gallery tour underground.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they navigate the Muni delays—it's all about timing those bus transfers like it's a well-rehearsed dance.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: The other day, a whole Muni train just stopped for 15 minutes because a squirrel decided to take a break on the tracks. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists ask for a 'cava' in fancy bars, but locals know the best ones are found in the dive bars by the plaça del Sol, where the bottles are dusty but the flavor’s rich.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them easily; they’re the ones taking photos of every tapas dish before taking a single bite at our local bars.
